import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

runtime = Path("src/do_again/browser/runtime.py")
tests = Path("tests/test_browser.py")

text = runtime.read_text()
old = """const raw = (conversation.innerText || conversation.textContent || '').replace(/\\r\\n/g, '\\n');
const labeled = 'You said:\\n' + needle;
return raw.includes(labeled);"""
new = """const raw = (conversation.innerText || conversation.textContent || '').split('\\r\\n').join('\\n');
const labeled = 'You said:\\n' + needle;
return raw.includes(labeled);"""
if old not in text:
    raise SystemExit("fallback normalization block not found")
runtime.write_text(text.replace(old, new))

subprocess.run(["python3", "-m", "unittest", "tests.test_browser"], check=True)
subprocess.run(["python3", "-m", "unittest", "discover", "-s", "tests", "-p", "test_*.py"], check=True)
subprocess.run(["git", "add", str(runtime)], check=True)
subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-m", "Fix receipt dedupe JavaScript fallback"], check=True)
subprocess.run(["git", "push", "origin", "main"], check=True)
print(subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip())
